sections.title: Built for Reproducible Scale-Up
sections.description: A test result that doesn't reproduce at industrial scale is a false start, not real progress. XStream Lab Homogenizer is designed around exactly that risk, ensuring what's proven on the benchtop carries over to full production. The NiSoX-Valve at the core of the system is the same technology behind GEA's industrial-scale homogenizers, so a lab test isn't approximating a different underlying process, it's running the actual one at smaller scale. Automatic pressure set-up and adjustment removes operator-to-operator variability from test runs, so a result reproduced next month, or by a different technician, matches the original.
